desc:
🚧 BETA 🚧 Expect bugs and daily updates! Your feedback shapes the game.
[Surprise at 500 likes!! 👀] <3

🛴 Ride scooters, BMX, MTB and skateboards in a giant redwood forest and beyond!

🌲 Drop in from the huge MEGA RAMP and fly over the gap
🏜️ Ride the canyon, forest trails, play games, or race your friends!
🌀 Tailwhips, barspins, flips, kickflips, grabs, grinds, manuals and endless lines
🔧 Build your ride from 1,200+ scooter, BMX and skate parts, with daily deals
🎨 Wraps, emotes and riding effects to show off your style
🎁 Ride 7 days in a row to win an animated deck wrap
🏗️ MY PARK: build your own skatepark with friends
🌍 Community Parks: share yours and ride the best from other players
🌙 MIDNIGHT RUN: a real pinball machine with a leaderboard to top
🚁 Fly the drone to scout your next line
🎮 Play on PC, mobile and console
🌐 Playable in 46 languages

Join the ScootX community with the 🌍 button in-game!

Made by a solo dev ❤️
